description: This file defines an abstract class 'PresenterInputMethod' that manages trace data, user options, and UI data for an input method viewer in a trace analysis tool. It handles trace entry updates, tree generation, filtering, and user interactions related to hierarchy and properties trees.

classes.name: PresenterInputMethod
classes.description: An abstract class managing trace data, user options, and UI updates for an input method trace viewer, including trace entry handling, tree generation, filtering, and user interaction methods.

methods.name: onTracePositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates UI data based on the current trace position, finds relevant trace entries, and regenerates the UI tree.

methods.name: updatePinnedItems
methods.description: Adds or removes a pinned item and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateHighlightedItems
methods.description: Highlights or unhighlights an item in the UI.

methods.name: updateHierarchyTree
methods.description: Updates hierarchy user options and regenerates the hierarchy tree.

methods.name: filterHierarchyTree
methods.description: Applies a filter to the hierarchy tree.

methods.name: updatePropertiesTree
methods.description: Updates properties user options and refreshes the properties tree.

methods.name: filterPropertiesTree
methods.description: Applies a filter to the properties tree.

methods.name: newPropertiesTree
methods.description: Sets a new selected item for properties tree and updates UI.

methods.name: newAdditionalPropertiesTree
methods.description: Creates a new additional properties tree node and updates UI.

methods.name: getAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Retrieves additional properties related to window manager and surface layers.

methods.name: generateTree
methods.description: Generates a hierarchy tree based on current entry and filters.

methods.name: updateSelectedTreeUiData
methods.description: Updates UI data for the selected hierarchy tree.

methods.name: updatePinnedIds
methods.description: Updates the list of pinned IDs.

methods.name: getTreeWithTransformedProperties
methods.description: Transforms a hierarchy tree into a properties tree with applied filters and options.

methods.name: findTraceEntries
methods.description: Finds trace entries corresponding to a given trace position.

methods.name: updateHierarchyTableProperties
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for updating hierarchy table properties.
